test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Mrs. Mane said that she regretted having supplied us with an inferior brand of TV set and was ready to apologise for that.

options.text: Mrs. Mane said, “I regret supplying you with an inferior brand of TV set and I am ready to apologise for that.”
Mrs. Mane said, “I am regretting having supplied you with an inferior brand of TV set and I am ready to apologise for that.”
Mrs. Mane said, “I regret having supplied you with an inferior brand of TV set and I am ready to apologise for that.”
Mrs. Mane said, “I regret to supply you with an inferior brand of TV set and I am ready to apologise for that.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **Mrs. Mane said, “I regret having supplied you with an inferior brand of TV set and I am ready to apologise for that.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This option correctly converts the reported speech back into direct speech, maintaining the original meaning and tense as implied by the reported speech.
